name: @agor/real-agor-e2e
description: Playwright E2E suite that drives the REAL Agor daemon + UI (isolated scratch DB, real login, real components) instead of the /demo/marketing-video fixture route. Doubles as both a regression test and a booth-loop video source (built-in Playwright video recording). Standalone install (not a pnpm workspace member) so Playwright stays out of the main workspace lockfile — same convention as ../ (the fixture capture pipeline).
